storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: Russian drone attacks resulted in the deaths of seven people across six Ukrainian regions, targeting infrastructure including a gas production facility and a thermal power plant. In response, Ukraine launched drone strikes on Russian oil refineries in the Samara and Rostov regions, as well as an airbase in Nizhny Novgorod, leading to at least one reported death in the Samara region.
